profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: A full stack software engineer, capable of building enterprise-level applications. Eager to learn.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build GraphQL microservices with Spring Boot (and NoSQL) to replace shared components in monolithic data pipeline,  hosted in AWS Kubernetes clusters.
Help implementing Apache Spark jobs running in Amazon EMR, replacing slow legacy jobs.
Support legacy Ruby/Java data pipeline, and Ruby on Rails web applications with Redis, Elasticache, and sharded MySQL database backend.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Help implement ETL process of NLM medical files into DITA cloud store. Built file update monitoring service, which triggers transforming of updated DITA into NLM and JSON formats that can be consumed by edge services and web UI applications. Microservices, Spring Batch, EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, FireHose, S3, cloud watch are used.
Maintain and improve back-end/mid-tier components. Use DB replication, table de-normalization and Memcached, to speed up large data retrieval from DB. Improve 
Helped implement authentication services, Jenkins pipeline, and devOps automation in OpenStack cloud.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented loading services with complex business logic to standardize HL7 data from various input sources and push them into Relational Databases.
Enhanced UI using JavaScript, Ajax, CSS, DHTML, and 3rd party tools like Dundas, ComponetArt, and Telerik.
Improved data retrieval performance by caching in frontend/backend, better DB table designs, and more efficient stored procedures.
